evidence: Completed purchase on 2026-08-31: one plush toy, guest checkout, Adyen card, end to end through the proxy. The account owner received Jellycat's order-confirmation email, which is the out-of-band receipt. A 2026-08-27 run reached Place Order and was declined by the issuer.
gotchas: PDP: press Enter on #form-action-addToCart does NOT add to bag; a real click after accepting OneTrust does (reproduced both runs).
PDP first page of a session: the Attentive popup intercepts even the OneTrust accept click; navigate once more (same session) and it is gone.
PDP: .countPill--positive is hidden — prove the add with count(), not a visible wait.
Checkout: an existing-account email swaps in a password form; the guest path is one click away ('continue as guest').
Payment: input[id*='credit'] matches #radio-paypalcommercecredit = PayPal PAY LATER, not the card method — select by the label text 'Card'.
Payment: each Adyen frame holds decoy autocomplete inputs; a bare 'input' selector hits 4 elements — use input[data-fieldtype=...].
Payment: the #terms label intercepts clicks — press Space on the checkbox, then verify #terms:checked.
Outcome: waiting on .orderConfirmation TIMES OUT even while the browser is navigating to the real confirmation page — success is the /checkout/order-confirmation URL + 'thank you' text.
Outcome: a decline keeps the card form filled; do not refill, just re-click Place Order once if retrying.
Session: bag lives in browser cookies — one session PDP→checkout; a day-old session throws 'Target page… has been closed' on open_page: close_session, then open_page again.

Blind agents: never re-click Place Order after a 'Clicked' with no alert and no navigation — poll the decline alert and the confirmation URL text with count() first; a double click risks a double charge.

Secondary selectors, moved out of overrides (values verbatim) to fit the 20-entry limit — URLs, BigCommerce defaults and duplicates: bag.url = https://us.jellycat.com/cart.php; checkout.url = https://us.jellycat.com/checkout; listing.productUrlPattern = https://us.jellycat.com/<slug>/; listing.search = https://us.jellycat.com/search.php?search_query=<term>  (untested); checkout.billingSameAsShipping = #sameAsBilling  (BigCommerce default, left checked); checkout.shippingMethodRadios = input[name="shippingOptionIds"]  (BigCommerce default; only one option appeared and auto-selected); checkout.shippingForm = #firstNameInput

Secondary selectors, continued (verbatim): payment.step = #checkout-payment-continue; payment.methodRadios = input[name="paymentProviderRadio"]; payment.payLaterTrap = #radio-paypalcommercecredit; pdp.quantity = #qty[name="qty[]"]  (BigCommerce default, untested here; default 1); pdp.sizeSoldOut = select:has(option[data-product-attribute-value]) option[disabled]; pdp.addToCartDisabledUntilSize = #form-action-addToCart (enabled without size on single-size items; select size first regardless); outcome.orderNumber = text=/order number|order #/i on /checkout/order-confirmation

COVERAGE — driven live (both runs unless noted): PDP size select, add to bag, bag-count proof, guest email step incl. the existing-account flip, shipping form, single-option shipping auto-select, Adyen card fill (CVV needed no live entry), terms, Place Order, decline path (08-27), full success path incl. the confirmation page (08-31). ASSUMED, not observed: listing/search URLs; PDP quantity (default 1); shipping-method radios when >1 option; billing=shipping (left at default); 3-D Secure (never triggered in two runs). NOT driven: signed-in path; PayPal; Apple/Google Pay.

SESSION RULES: PDP to checkout in ONE session (a close/open starts an empty bag; in-session navigations keep it, 3+ proven). Idle >60s never killed a session in either run, and batching independent count() probes in parallel was safe. The full walk is ~25 calls following these overrides (~45 with first-run probing). Listing: products at /<slug>/ (lowercase hyphenated name, e.g. /peanut-penguin/, still valid, and /amuseables-sun/); categories like /animals/arctic-antarctic; a web search for 'jellycat.com <toy name>' returns the slug.
notes: Two live runs with agent-pay (blind). 2026-08-27: full walk to Place Order, issuer declined (card-side). 2026-08-31: COMPLETE PURCHASE end-to-end in ~25 calls. Cloudflare 403s curl/fetch; the proxied browser passes. || PDP: accept OneTrust (pdp.cookieAccept) first; on a session's first page the Attentive popup (pdp.smsPopup) blocks even that, so navigate once more. Size is a native <select> (pdp.sizeSelect); check sold-out options first. Real click on pdp.addToCart; prove it with count() on pdp.bagCountProof = '1'. || CHECKOUT (go to /checkout; skip /cart.php): checkout.email, checkout.customerContinue; an existing-account email flips to a password form, so click checkout.continueAsGuest and #firstNameInput appears within ~5s. Fill checkout.shippingFields in order (country before state; both <select>), then checkout.shippingContinue; a single shipping option auto-selects. || PAYMENT: 5 radios; choose the card with payment.cardMethodRadio; Adyen mounts number/expiry/CVC iframes plus a holder-name input ~2s later. Fill payment.* (expiry MM/YY), press Space on payment.terms. Preflight: #terms:checked = 1, outcome.fieldErrors = 0, payment.placeOrder not disabled; then ONE click. || OUTCOME: success = navigation to /checkout/order-confirmation plus text=/thank you/i and an order number (this recipe's former .orderConfirmation never matches on this theme). Decline = outcome.declineAlert; the page stays on /checkout with the card still filled.

overrides.outcome.orderConfirmation: URL navigates to /checkout/order-confirmation; then text=/thank you/i. Previous value '.orderConfirmation' is WRONG on this theme — it never matched, even on the real confirmation page (2026-08-31)
